classification: Evidence and proposed refinements; NOT an approved contract amendment

findings.fact: Account terms kind/version/digest evidence required, but no client discovery route, registered version fixture or content registry ownership/materialization specified
findings.recommendation: Expose public immutable Account terms manifests with exact version, required item kinds and content digests. Start/finish echo that exact version. Resolve bytes from an Account-owned versioned content registry; do not use Company audit or infer historic consent.
alternatives: Prefer Account-owned immutable terms content and current-version head when existing object engine supports this custody
Release-pinned immutable public artifact is simpler initially, but loses runtime governed publication unless explicitly integrated
settle_before_test: Exact GET manifest/content routes and response schema
Content owner/storage, current-version publication and stale-in-flight registration policy
Test-only registered content bytes and digest; no production/legal acceptance claim

findings.fact: Finish result names Account session but no exact body envelope or successful status; start fields are specified
findings.recommendation: Reuse WebAuthn library publicKey serialization exactly. Propose start200; registration finish201; login finish200; explicit Account projection envelope. Browser response contains Account projection only plus session cookies; native bearer response may contain access/refresh credentials under explicit transport negotiation.
settle_before_test: Exact response JSON Schema and additionalProperties policy
Native transport selector, omitted-selector behavior and mixed-cookie/bearer conflict rules
Typed assurance values and permitted_self_actions ActionRef codec

findings.fact: Secure HttpOnly host-only cookies plus Origin and session-bound CSRF required; cookie names,path,proof acquisition and middleware are expressly deferred
findings.recommendation: Separate v2 Account cookies from legacy console_refresh; prefer __Host- names, Secure,HttpOnly,Path=/, no Domain, SameSite=Strict. Require same-origin mutation policy and session-bound CSRF. Preserve hash-only enrollment nonce custody.
alternatives: Random synchronizer proof with owner-managed hash/state: familiar but needs refresh/reload/multiple-tab lifetime contract

Signed CSRF proof with separate audience/kind, bound to current family+generation using existing ES256 keys: avoids a second secret/store but needs strict parser separation and cookie-authenticated proof acquisition
settle_before_test: Choose CSRF mechanism and specify issuance/refresh/reload/multiple-tab behavior
Exact cookie names/max-age/clearing and logout/duplicate-cookie parsing
Enrollment nonce cookie binding and expiration; concurrent registration behavior

findings.fact: GN16 already admits contexts route, page_size1..100/default25,5minute cursors,401/409stale_cursor/503navigation_unavailable; earlier AS1 deferral is superseded
findings.recommendation: Fix one closed envelope for COMPANY/GROUP contexts and exact context_ref/entry_ref/label codecs. No hidden count; choosing context grants nothing; GET cannot create CompanyActor.
settle_before_test: Exact context/result/error JSON schemas and typed refs
Empty vs denied vs unavailable results with zero contexts
Genuine owner-issued entitlement fixture plus candidate hints; hints alone cannot make success
